name: How long does bathroom molding installation usually take?

mainEntity.name: How long does bathroom molding installation usually take?

acceptedAnswer.text: A standard bathroom molding project typically takes one to two days to complete. The exact timeline depends on the linear footage, whether crown, baseboard, or beadboard trim is installed, and the scope of surface prep. Installing molding onto uneven drywall or around existing tile edges takes extra time to scribe, cope, and fit tightly. Painting, caulking seams, and letting waterproof sealants cure add another day before the room can be exposed to heavy shower moisture.
acceptedAnswer.description: Most bathroom trim projects take one to two days, with extra time needed for caulking and paint to dry before heavy shower use.
